description: Sample benchmark for the bundled corpus. v1 (20 questions) extended with key facts, expected sources, PDF page references, DOCX, conflicting sources, comparison/multi-fact, prompt-injection and 4 unanswerable questions.

examples.question: How many days do I have to return a product for a refund?
examples.expected_answer: You have 30 days from the date of purchase to return a product for a full refund.
examples.reference_context: The company's refund policy allows customers to return any product within 30 days of purchase for a full refund.

examples.question: How long does it take to process a refund?
examples.expected_answer: Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after the returned item is received.
examples.reference_context: Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after the returned item is received by our warehouse.

examples.question: Are digital products refundable?
examples.expected_answer: No, digital products and gift cards are non-refundable.
examples.reference_context: Digital products and gift cards are non-refundable.

examples.question: How long is the warranty on hardware products?
examples.expected_answer: Hardware products come with a one-year manufacturer warranty.
examples.reference_context: All hardware products come with a one-year manufacturer warranty covering manufacturing defects.

examples.question: Does the warranty cover accidental damage?
examples.expected_answer: No, the warranty does not cover accidental damage, water damage, or normal wear and tear.
examples.reference_context: The warranty does not cover accidental damage, water damage, or normal wear and tear.

examples.question: How many paid leave days do full-time employees get per year?
examples.expected_answer: Full-time employees are entitled to 20 paid leave days per calendar year.
examples.reference_context: Full-time employees are entitled to 20 paid leave days per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

examples.question: How many unused leave days can be carried over to the next year?
examples.expected_answer: Up to a maximum of 5 unused leave days can be carried over.
examples.reference_context: Unused leave days can be carried over to the next year up to a maximum of 5 days.

examples.question: How long is maternity leave at the company?
examples.expected_answer: Maternity leave is 26 weeks, fully paid.
examples.reference_context: Maternity leave is 26 weeks and paternity leave is 2 weeks, both fully paid.

examples.question: What are the standard working hours?
examples.expected_answer: Standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday, with a one-hour lunch break.
examples.reference_context: Standard working hours are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday, with a one-hour lunch break.

examples.question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
examples.expected_answer: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week.
examples.reference_context: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week.

examples.question: Within how many days must employees submit expense receipts?
examples.expected_answer: Employees must submit receipts within 30 days of the expense.
examples.reference_context: Employees must submit receipts within 30 days of the expense.

examples.question: Where is the company's headquarters located?
examples.expected_answer: The company's headquarters is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.
examples.reference_context: The company's headquarters is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

examples.question: How much storage does the Pro plan of CloudSync Pro include?
examples.expected_answer: The FAQ lists 1TB for the Pro plan; the January 2026 pricing update states 2TB.
examples.reference_context: the Pro plan at $12 per month with 1TB storage | Effective 1 January 2026, the Pro plan costs $15 per month and includes 2TB of storage.

examples.question: What encryption does CloudSync Pro use to protect files?
examples.expected_answer: CloudSync Pro uses AES-256 encryption both during transfer and while stored on servers.
examples.reference_context: All files are encrypted using AES-256 encryption both during transfer and while stored on our servers.

examples.question: How many days of version history does the Basic plan keep?
examples.expected_answer: The Basic plan keeps 7 days of version history.
examples.reference_context: CloudSync Pro keeps up to 30 days of version history for every file on the Pro and Business plans, and 7 days on the Basic plan.

examples.question: What happens to files after I cancel my CloudSync Pro subscription?
examples.expected_answer: Files remain accessible in read-only mode for 30 days before being permanently deleted.
examples.reference_context: Upon cancellation, files remain accessible in read-only mode for 30 days before being permanently deleted.

examples.question: What operating systems does CloudSync Pro support?
examples.expected_answer: CloudSync Pro is available on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.
examples.reference_context: CloudSync Pro is available on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

examples.question: How much RAM is required to run the CloudSync Pro desktop client?
examples.expected_answer: At least 4GB of RAM is required.
examples.reference_context: CloudSync Pro requires at least 4GB of RAM and 500MB of free disk space for the desktop client.

examples.question: At what storage usage percentage does CloudSync Pro send an alert email?
examples.expected_answer: An email notification is sent at 90% of the storage limit.
examples.reference_context: Users receive an email notification when they reach 90% of their storage limit.

examples.question: What is the capital of France?
examples.expected_answer: I don't know based on the provided documents.

examples.question: How often do automatic backups run in CloudSync Pro?
examples.expected_answer: Automatic backups run every 6 hours on all plans.
examples.reference_context: Automatic backups run every 6 hours on all plans.

examples.question: How long are backup snapshots kept on the Business plan?
examples.expected_answer: Backup snapshots are retained for 90 days on the Business plan.
examples.reference_context: Backup snapshots are retained for 90 days on the Business plan and 30 days on other plans.

examples.question: What is the daily meal allowance for domestic business travel?
examples.expected_answer: Employees travelling within India receive a daily meal allowance of INR 1,500.
examples.reference_context: Employees travelling for business within India receive a daily meal allowance of INR 1,500.

examples.question: What is the monthly price of the CloudSync Pro Pro plan?
examples.expected_answer: The FAQ lists $12 per month, but the January 2026 pricing update says the Pro plan costs $15 per month from 1 January 2026.
examples.reference_context: the Pro plan at $12 per month | Effective 1 January 2026, the Pro plan costs $15 per month

examples.question: Compare how much version history the Basic plan and the Pro plan keep.
examples.expected_answer: The Basic plan keeps 7 days of version history; the Pro (and Business) plan keeps up to 30 days.
examples.reference_context: CloudSync Pro keeps up to 30 days of version history for every file on the Pro and Business plans, and 7 days on the Basic plan.

examples.question: Which support channels do Pro plan users get, and how long is version history on that plan?
examples.expected_answer: Pro plan users get email and live chat support, and version history is kept for up to 30 days.
examples.reference_context: Support is available via email for all plans, with live chat support included in the Pro and Business plans. | up to 30 days of version history for every file on the Pro and Business plans

examples.question: What is the name of the guest Wi-Fi network in the Chennai office?
examples.expected_answer: The guest Wi-Fi network is named ATN-Guest.
examples.reference_context: The guest Wi-Fi network in the Chennai office is named ATN-Guest.

examples.question: Who is the CEO of the company?
examples.expected_answer: I don't know based on the provided documents.

examples.question: Does CloudSync Pro offer a free trial?
examples.expected_answer: I don't know based on the provided documents.

examples.question: How many unused sick days can be carried over to the next year?
examples.expected_answer: I don't know based on the provided documents.
examples.reference_context: Sick leave is separate and provides up to 10 paid sick days per year. (Carry-over is only stated for regular leave days.)
